WITH race_coverage AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.round, r.race_id,
           EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main.results AS x WHERE x.race_id = r.race_id) AS has_results,
           EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main.driver_standings AS d WHERE d.race_id = r.race_id) AS has_driver_standings,
           EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main.constructor_standings AS c WHERE c.race_id = r.race_id) AS has_constructor_standings,
           EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main.constructor_results AS c WHERE c.race_id = r.race_id) AS has_constructor_results
    FROM main.races AS r
)
SELECT year, MAX(round) AS last_scheduled_round,
       MAX(CASE WHEN has_results THEN round END) AS last_results_round,
       MAX(CASE WHEN has_driver_standings THEN round END) AS last_driver_standings_round,
       MAX(CASE WHEN has_constructor_standings THEN round END) AS last_constructor_standings_round,
       MAX(CASE WHEN has_constructor_results THEN round END) AS last_constructor_results_round
FROM race_coverage
GROUP BY year
HAVING year < 1960 OR year >= 2020
   OR last_scheduled_round IS NOT last_results_round
   OR last_results_round IS NOT last_driver_standings_round
   OR last_driver_standings_round IS NOT last_constructor_standings_round
   OR last_constructor_standings_round IS NOT last_constructor_results_round
ORDER BY year

arguments.sql:
WITH last_round AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(round) AS round
    FROM main.races AS r
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main.driver_standings AS d WHERE d.race_id = r.race_id)
    GROUP BY year
),
standing_totals AS (
    SELECT r.year, d.driver_id, d.points
    FROM main.driver_standings AS d
    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.race_id = d.race_id
    JOIN last_round AS lr ON lr.year = r.year AND lr.round = r.round
),
race_totals AS (
    SELECT r.year, x.driver_id, SUM(x.points) AS points
    FROM main.results AS x
    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.race_id = x.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, x.driver_id
),
standing_ranked AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY points DESC) AS point_rank
    FROM standing_totals
),
race_ranked AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY points DESC) AS point_rank
    FROM race_totals
)
SELECT s.year, sd.full_name AS standings_name, s.points AS standings_points,
       rd.full_name AS result_name, r.points AS result_points
FROM standing_ranked AS s
JOIN race_ranked AS r ON r.year = s.year
JOIN main.drivers AS sd ON sd.driver_id = s.driver_id
JOIN main.drivers AS rd ON rd.driver_id = r.driver_id
WHERE s.point_rank = 1 AND r.point_rank = 1 AND s.driver_id <> r.driver_id
ORDER BY s.year
